q: By what nickname are Portsmouth universally known?
hint: Pompey is also the long-standing naval slang for the city of Portsmouth itself, and the club, ground and chant all carry it.

q: Portsmouth won the FA Cup in 2008, beating which club in the final?
hint: Cardiff were a Championship side; Portsmouth won 1-0 at Wembley for their first major trophy in nearly 60 years.

q: Who scored Portsmouth's winning goal in the 2008 FA Cup final?
hint: Kanu bundled in the only goal after a goalkeeping error; the Nigerian had won the trophy twice before with Arsenal.

q: Which manager led Portsmouth to the 2008 FA Cup?
hint: Redknapp had also taken Portsmouth into the Premier League in 2003; Grant managed the club in the 2010 final.

q: Portsmouth won back-to-back English league titles in which years?
hint: The two First Division titles came either side of the club's 50th anniversary and remain its only league championships.

q: Which ground has been Portsmouth's home since 1899?
hint: Fratton Park is one of the oldest continuously used grounds in English league football.

q: In 2010 Portsmouth became the first club to do what while playing in the Premier League?
hint: The administration brought a nine-point deduction and the club was relegated that same season.

q: Portsmouth lost the 2010 FA Cup final to which club?
hint: Chelsea won 1-0 through Didier Drogba, completing the Double; Portsmouth reached the final while in administration.

q: Portsmouth's fiercest rivalry, the South Coast derby, is with which club?
hint: The cities sit under 20 miles apart, and the rivalry is among the most intense in English football.

q: Which one-club man holds Portsmouth's record for appearances, with 764?
hint: Dickinson spent his entire career at Fratton Park and later managed the club; his tally is one of the highest for any English one-club player.

q: Alan Knight set a remarkable Portsmouth record in which position?
hint: Knight made over 680 appearances in goal across more than two decades, a record for a goalkeeper at a single English club.

q: Portsmouth ended a 15-year absence from the top flight by winning promotion in which year?
hint: They won the First Division title in 2002-03 to reach the Premier League after a 15-year absence.

q: After successive relegations, Portsmouth were bought in 2013 by which group?
hint: The fan buyout made Portsmouth the largest supporter-owned club in England at the time, with the club then in the fourth tier.

q: Which England international was Portsmouth's number one during the 2008 FA Cup run?
hint: James joined in 2006 and kept goal throughout the cup run; he later held the Premier League clean-sheet record.

q: Which England defender, a Premier League title winner with Arsenal, joined Portsmouth in 2006?
hint: Campbell captained the side and played in the 2008 final, having been part of Arsenal's unbeaten league season.

q: The famous Portsmouth chant known as the Pompey Chimes takes its rhythm from what?
hint: It echoes the chimes of the nearby town hall clock and is one of the oldest surviving chants in English football.

q: Guy Whittingham set a Portsmouth club record in 1992-93 for what?
o: Most league goals in a season
Most red cards in a season
hint: Whittingham scored 42 league goals that season, a tally no Portsmouth player has approached since.

q: What colour shirts do Portsmouth traditionally play in?
hint: The royal blue home shirt, usually with white shorts and red socks, has been the club's identity for over a century.
